column1: # mapping_set_description: Property correspondences applied by ConvertToCroissant.py (CDIF -> Croissant 1.1).
#   Structural transforms the converter performs that are not term-to-term
#   mappings (so they have no TSV row):
#   - CDIF-only discovery/provenance properties (prov:wasGeneratedBy, dqv:hasQualityMeasurement, schema:spatialCoverage, ...) are passed through verbatim with namespace prefixes added to @context.
#   - Croissant conformsTo is set to http://mlcommons.org/croissant/1.1; the CDIF schema:subjectOf block is passed through.

#   - Field dataType derives from the variable's data type: xsd:decimal/float/double -> sc:Float, xsd:integer/int/long -> sc:Integer, xsd:date/dateTime -> sc:Date, xsd:boolean -> sc:Boolean, String -> sc:Text.
